name: ownpurse-admin
description: The ownpurse admin: a UIx app over the ownpurse API, served by ownpurse at /admin.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n cljs,css -c blue,magenta "shadow-cljs watch app" "tailwindcss -i src/admin.css -o resources/ownpurse/admin/admin.css --watch=always"
scripts.build: tailwindcss -i src/admin.css -o resources/ownpurse/admin/admin.css --minify && shadow-cljs release app
